GPOS positioning tables, ported from harfrust ot/lookup/gpos.rs.

Scope: static and variable fonts. ValueRecord device offsets that reference VariationIndex tables apply GDEF variation deltas at the active normalized coordinates; plain Device tables (hinting) are ignored, as are anchor contour points. Wide (24-bit, beyond-64K) formats 3/4 and coverage/class 3/4 are supported. Extension (type 9) flattens inner SinglePos, PairPos, cursive, mark attachments, and contextual positioning (types 7/8 share the GSUB SequenceContext/ChainedSequenceContext layouts and rule engine).

                      parentBase: int): ValueRecord {....raises: [FontError],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Parses base values plus per-value device/VariationIndex offsets. Device offsets resolve against parentBase (the immediate parent table: SinglePos/PairPosFormat2 subtable, or PairSet); a VariationIndex table (deltaFormat 0x8000) yields a packed index, anything else (device tables, NULL, malformed) keeps the NoVariationIndex sentinel.
